resources.string: Share AI across phones
On each helper phone, open Helper device and tap Start sharing.
On the main phone, open Main device. It finds the helpers on your Wi-Fi.
Choose a model and start. The model is split across all the phones.
Chat and text models
Images and video
Use this phone to run a model
Main device (master): this phone loads the model and does the chatting. Helper phones lend their memory so bigger models fit.
Open Main device
Lend this phone\'s memory
Helper device (worker): another phone runs the model and borrows part of this phone\'s memory over Wi-Fi.
Open Helper device
Share image and video jobs
Use several phones together to generate images and video with Stable Diffusion.
Before you start
All phones must be on the same Wi-Fi network. A faster network (5 GHz) means faster answers.
Turn off any VPN or guest-network mode while sharing. They can stop the phones from seeing each other.
Sharing is not encrypted. Only use it on a network you trust, like your home Wi-Fi.
Helper device
Choose how much memory to lend, then tap Start sharing.
On the main device, this phone shows up in the helper list by itself. If it does not, add it there with the address shown here.
Keep this phone awake and on Wi-Fi. The main device does the rest.
Ready to share
Nothing is shared until you tap Start sharing.
Not enough free memory
Free at least %1$d MB of memory (close other apps) to share this phone.
Waiting for the main device
Sharing %1$s of memory as \"%2$s\". Start the search on the main device, or scan the QR code below.
Main device connected
It is using %1$s of this phone\'s memory. Keep the phone on Wi-Fi until you stop sharing.
Connect the main device
On the main device, this phone shows up in the helper list by itself. If it does not, tap Add a helper manually and enter this address.
Or add this phone by hand with this address
Memory to lend
The main device can use up to this much of this phone\'s memory to hold part of the model. Lend less to keep this phone smooth, or more so the main device can run bigger models.
This amount is not enforced on this phone. Enter the same amount for this phone on the main device so it plans with it.
Kept for Android
Lending to the main device
Advanced settings
These settings can be changed while sharing is stopped.
Processor threads: %1$d
More threads can be faster but heat the phone and slow other apps. Four is a good start.
Remember model parts
Keeps the model parts this phone received, so reconnecting to the same model is much faster. Uses storage.
Stored on this phone: %1$s
Clear stored model parts
Connection port: %1$d. The main device uses it to reach this phone; it is chosen automatically.
Watch the main device (advanced)
Open the web page of the main device on this phone to follow the chat. Enter its address and port.
